okto_pulse_get_card.title: Get card details.
okto_pulse_get_card.description: Returns full card details including attachments, Q&A, and comments.

okto_pulse_update_card.title: Update card details.
okto_pulse_update_card.description: Pass only fields you want to change; omit the rest. Fields not passed are unchanged.

title.description: Novo titulo do card (opcional, vazio = sem mudanca).
title.title: Title

status.description: Novo status do card (use move_card para transicoes com conclusao).

priority.description: Nova prioridade: none, low, medium, high, very_high, critical.

position.description: Nova posicao do card dentro da coluna (zero-indexed).
position.title: Position

assignee_id.description: Novo ID do responsavel pelo card.
assignee_id.title: Assignee Id

labels.description: Novas tags de categorizacao do card.
labels.title: Labels

spec_id.description: Novo ID da spec vinculada ao card.
spec_id.title: Spec Id

sprint_id.description: Novo ID do sprint ao qual o card pertence.
sprint_id.title: Sprint Id

test_scenario_ids.description: Novos IDs de test scenarios vinculados ao card; respeita board.settings.max_scenarios_per_card.
test_scenario_ids.title: Test Scenario Ids

screen_mockups.description: Novos mockups de tela vinculados ao card.
screen_mockups.title: Screen Mockups

knowledge_bases.description: Base de conhecimento vinculada ao card (lista de dicts).
knowledge_bases.title: Knowledge Bases

severity.description: Nova severidade do bug: 'critical', 'major' ou 'minor' (apenas bug cards).
severity.title: Severity

steps_to_reproduce.description: Passos para reproducao atualizados (apenas bug cards).
steps_to_reproduce.title: Steps To Reproduce

action_plan.description: Plano de acao atualizado para correcao do bug (apenas bug cards).
action_plan.title: Action Plan

linked_test_task_ids.description: IDs dos cards de teste vinculados a este bug (apenas bug cards).
linked_test_task_ids.title: Linked Test Task Ids

okto_pulse_move_card.title: Move a card to a different column on the board.
okto_pulse_move_card.description: Moving to validation or done requires conclusion, completeness, and drift.

status.description: Novo status do card: not_started, started, in_progress, validation, on_hold, done, cancelled.

position.description: Nova posicao na coluna de destino (-1 ou None = fim da coluna).
position.title: Position

conclusion.description: Resumo obrigatorio ao mover para 'validation' ou 'done': o que foi feito, arquivos, decisoes e testes.
conclusion.title: Conclusion

completeness.description: 0-100: quanto do trabalho planejado foi implementado (obrigatorio em validation/done).
completeness.title: Completeness

completeness_justification.description: Justificativa para o score de completeness (obrigatorio em validation/done).
completeness_justification.title: Completeness Justification

drift.description: 0-100: o quanto a implementacao desviou do plano (0=exato, 100=completamente diferente).
drift.title: Drift

drift_justification.description: Justificativa para o score de drift — explica desvios do plano original.
drift_justification.title: Drift Justification

okto_pulse_delete_card.title: Delete a card from the board.

okto_pulse_list_cards_by_status.title: List cards with optional filters and pagination.
okto_pulse_list_cards_by_status.description: Returns filtered/paginated cards and summary counts.

status.description: Filter by status (optional, empty = all). Values: not_started, started, in_progress, validation, on_hold, done, cancelled, open.

spec_id.description: Filter to cards linked to this spec (optional).

priority.description: Filter by priority (optional). Values: none, low, medium, high, very_high, critical.
